findings.governingReading: Shirou acknowledges Rin’s report, then says her presence was a great help.
findings.explanation: Sorry invents an apology and alters the opening beat of his gratitude.

findings.highlight: I thought you went out looking for Shinji, and Saber was like that
findings.evidenceJa: 帰ってきたと思ったらセイバーがアレでしょう
findings.governingReading: Rin says Shirou went looking for Shinji and, when he returned, Saber was in that condition.
findings.explanation: I thought falsely makes the expedition uncertain and loses the return-then-discovery relation.

findings.highlight: ways to heal a Servant who ran out of magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを以前の状態に戻す方法
findings.governingReading: Rin gives two ways to return Saber to her former condition.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes Saber’s case into healing any fully depleted Servant, although Saber still has some energy and the issue is sustained existence and combat capacity.
